seoDescription: Your space is already deciding how you live. A free first conversation, or a one-hour consultation, with Petrina Salema in Vienna.
hook: Your space is already deciding how you live. Stop decorating around a life you didn't choose. Shape the rooms that define how you want to rest, gather, and think.

projectOffer.title: Full project
projectOffer.body: A redesign of how a home or room operates. How a family or guests move through it, then layout, materials, sourcing, and styling.
projectOffer.note: A few residences a year. Most take one to three months, in person in Vienna, and remotely abroad.
projectOffer.finance: A quote comes after the first conversation. A deposit starts the project, then billing in stages until the last invoice.

consultOffer.title: One hour consultation
consultOffer.body: In one focused hour, you leave with the changes that would matter most, and a clear next step.
